Read a basemap view

Source: R/basemap.R
get_bounds.Rd

  • get_bounds(): the view's extent, c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) in EPSG:3857 metres, or degrees with lonlat = TRUE.

  • get_center(): c(longitude, latitude) of the centre.

  • get_zoom(): the MapLibre zoom.

  • get_size(): c(width, height) of rendered images in device pixels.

Usage

get_bounds(m, lonlat = FALSE)

get_center(m)

get_zoom(m)

get_size(m)

Arguments

m

A basemap() object.

lonlat

Return degrees (EPSG:4326) instead of EPSG:3857 metres.

Value

A named numeric vector.

Details

Python: m.get_bounds(), m.get_center(), m.get_zoom(), m.get_size().
